items.title: Gold slips as investors await Fed rate signals
items.summary: Gold prices fell slightly as investors monitored the Federal Reserve's major interest rate decision. The anticipated meeting will provide key insights into future economic policies. Economists expect the Fed to hold rates steady, emphasizing inflation concerns. The Bank of Japan is also projected to raise interest rates in December. Other precious metals, including silver and platinum, experienced minimal changes during this period.
